findings.F1: A coin's one-day return, scaled by its 20-day volatility, reverses on the next day. The Spearman correlation with the next day's excess return is -0.075 (p = 1.5e-7, n = 4834 non-overlapping days). It holds in each coin (BTC -0.070, p = 6e-4; ETH -0.079, p = 9e-5) and in each half of the windows (w1-12: -0.101; w13-24: -0.054, p = 0.008).
findings.F2: The one-day reversal sits almost entirely in the coin's most volatile third of days, by 20-day volatility. There the correlation is -0.166 (p = 2e-11, n = 1612) and the slope on the raw return is -0.149. In the low and middle volatility thirds it is only -0.027 and -0.027 (p ≈ 0.27–0.28).
findings.F3: The reversal lasts one day only.
findings.F4: The one-day reversal is stronger in some years than others. It is significant in 2018 (-0.137), 2019 (-0.086), 2020 (-0.155) and 2023 (-0.138). It is near zero in 2022, 2024 and 2025 (-0.016 to -0.027, p > 0.49), so it varies with the period. Its sign is negative in all 8 years.
findings.F5: The tested divergence adds nothing at the bar level. On new 30-day lows, the 20-day excess return is +4.2 % with the divergence (n = 5) and +2.5 % without it (n = 8), both with |t| < 0.3. At 5 days it is +0.65 % with (n = 20) and +0.55 % without (n = 29).
findings.F6: The book is almost never in the market, so it earns almost nothing.
findings.F7: Momentum over 30 days to the next 5 days is weak and unstable. The pooled correlation is +0.079 (p = 0.021, n = 851), but it is significant only in ETH (p = 0.03) and in the later half of the windows (p = 0.03). It has no significant year, and its sign is negative in 4 of 8 years. Across this many angles it does not stand apart from chance.

ideas.idea: On a coin's high-volatility days, measured by its 20-day volatility, the next day's return runs against the day just closed. The larger that day's return relative to its 20-day volatility, the larger the move back over the next 1 day.
ideas.consequence: After a large daily move in a volatile spell, a trader leans against it for one day and refuses to chase it, and does not carry that lean beyond the next day.
ideas.name: Volatile-day one-day reversal
